# LongBench attribution

LongBench is by THU-KEG and Zhipu AI. Upstream:
<https://github.com/THUDM/LongBench> (now redirected to the maintainers' current
organization). Its upstream MIT notice is preserved in `LongBench-LICENSE`.

The artifact's experimental result logs retain model-generated predictions and
scoring references so recorded F1 can be rechecked. Source input documents,
original QA JSONL files and dataset archives are excluded from the public bundle.
Obtain datasets from their original providers under their applicable terms; the
repository's Apache-2.0 code license does not relicense source dataset material.
The paper cites LongBench and the preparation runbook records retrieval hashes.
